title: the 2024 instance of the same defect, with the store context deleted first
live_proof: inspection at the 17.0 pin plus the upstream commit: parallel_vacuum_reset_dead_items (src/backend/commands/vacuumparallel.c:473) keeps a local `dead_items`, destroys the store through it at :483, recreates into pvs->dead_items at :484, and then reads the DESTROYED local at :488-489. Upstream 83ce20d671 (2024-12-04, 'Fix use-after-free in parallel_vacuum_reset_dead_items') removes that local and destroys through pvs->dead_items instead; it postdates the 17.0 release of 2024-09-26, so the pre-fix shape is present at the pin.
lifetime_ender: TidStoreDestroy through the callee's local, which deletes the store's child context and then pfrees the struct the local still points at
shape: stale pointer to a recreated object
distinguishing: the callee's own local is stale here; case 1 is the caller's field, a separate defect at the same site fixed ten months later
